intro: RiceCall is a place to chat, sing and make friends together. To keep it safe for everyone, please follow these rules. Accounts or groups that break them may be warned, muted, suspended or disbanded by the moderation team, depending on the case.

sections.title: 1. Respect others
items: Do not insult, harass, threaten or bully other users
Do not post content that discriminates by race, gender, religion, nationality, sexual orientation or disability
Do not share other people's personal information (real name, address, phone number, photos and so on)

sections.title: 2. Content
items: Do not send pornographic, nude or sexually suggestive content; anything involving minors is strictly forbidden and will be reported to the authorities
Do not send gory or violent content, or content that encourages self-harm or crime
Do not spread rumours, false information or content that infringes copyright

sections.title: 3. Scams and advertising
items: Do not scam others or ask for money, items, accounts or passwords
Do not send unsolicited ads, promotions, floods or repeated messages
Do not promote gambling, illegal trade or other unlawful activities

sections.title: 4. Accounts and identity
items: Do not impersonate staff, moderators or other users
Do not buy, sell, rent or share accounts
Do not use additional accounts to evade a suspension or penalty

sections.title: 5. Groups and channels
items: Group owners and admins must moderate their groups by these rules and must not allow violations
Group names, avatars, announcements and channel names are covered by these rules too
Do not abuse moderation powers to harass or target members

sections.title: 6. Voice and streaming
items: Do not play disruptive noise or music in voice channels
Do not record or rebroadcast other people's voice or video without consent
Streams and performances are covered by these rules too

sections.title: 7. Security
items: Do not use cheats, bots or modified clients
Do not attack, break into or disrupt RiceCall services
Report vulnerabilities to us; do not exploit or share them

sections.title: 8. Reports and appeals
items: To report a violation, choose Report in the direct message window or the group settings, and attach screenshots or other evidence
Do not file false or repeated reports
To appeal a penalty, use the feedback form

sections.title: 9. Changes
sections.paragraph: These rules may change at any time; continuing to use RiceCall means you accept the changes. Cases not listed here are decided by the moderation team under the Terms of Service.
